message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of an agent skill being refined through minibatch edits, validation, and epoch-level reflection.","description":"A process diagram shows skill optimization in two linked stages. At upper left, a DATASET panel lists “Train split: rollout evidence,” “Validation split: update gate,” and “Test split: locked until final report”; a lock icon marks the test split. A robot labeled “Fixed Agent” points to a blue skill-document icon labeled “S_t,” with “skill document S_t” and “trainable module” beneath it. The skill and rollout evidence feed a “Rollout batch,” pictured as small trajectory, trace, and score cards. The rollout batch branches to “mini-batch 1,” “mini-batch 2,” and “mini-batch K,” with dots indicating intervening batches. Each batch points to an “Optimizer model,” then to a box labeled “L atomic edits per mini-batch,” containing ADD, DEL, and REP (add/delete/replace). Arrows from the edit boxes converge on “Batch-level merge,” which deduplicates and resolves conflicts. The merged edits flow to “Rank/clip by edit budget L_t,” alongside an “LR schedule: decay L_t” box. The resulting “L_t merged edits” go to “Modifier bounded text update,” which includes a “slow-update field (epoch-only field),” producing a candidate skill S_{t+1}. The candidate enters a diamond-shaped “Validation gate.” A green rightward arrow labeled “accept” leads to the current skill S_{t+1}, which points to “best_skill.md,” labeled “best validated skill.” A red dashed downward arrow labeled “reject” leads to a “rejected-edit buffer”; a red dashed return path runs left from the buffer and points back into the batch-level merge.\n\nA teal dashed enclosure below is titled “EPOCH-WISE SLOW/META UPDATE.” “After one epoch” branches to “previous epoch skill” and “current epoch skill.” Each points to a small trajectory/trace/score card; the note beneath says “same sample, different skills.” Four colored outcome boxes—“improvements,” “regressions,” “persistent failures,” and “stable successes”—each point to “Epoch-wise reflection.” From reflection, one teal dashed path labeled “Slow update” routes upward to the modifier’s slow-update field, and another points to an “Optimizer meta-skill” box. That box lists “which edits helped,” “which edits failed,” and “remaining failure patterns.” A teal dashed route from the meta-skill extends right and upward toward the current-skill area, annotated “update future Optimize model calls.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
